manual_edits.why: Neither value admitted Drupal 11; strategy auto resolved to keep-d10 (no BC break, minor bump). composer.json already declared require.php >=8.1, the exact value core-strategy.sh recommends.

manual_edits.edit: src/Entity/LegacyWidget.php: renamed getOriginal() to getOriginalWidget() (body unchanged: $this->original ?? NULL) and its only caller in modules/legacy_widgets_extra/legacy_widgets_extra.module
manual_edits.why: Core adds EntityInterface::getOriginal(): ?static in 11.2; the untyped module method made the entity class fatal at load on 11.2+ (all 5 Kernel tests red in the baseline). Keeping the name with : ?static would recurse through __isset()/__get(); core getOriginal() does not exist below 11.2, so the module-specific name is the Drupal 10-safe fix.

manual_edits.edit: src/Form/SettingsForm.php: inject config.typed (TypedConfigManagerInterface) and forward it to ConfigFormBase::__construct()
manual_edits.why: ConfigFormBase::__construct() requires the typed config manager from Drupal 11.0 (ArgumentCountError otherwise); PHP ignores the extra argument on Drupal 10.0/10.1 (core matrix: runtime-tolerated).

manual_edits.edit: src/Form/WidgetImportForm.php: stop redeclaring FormBase::$loggerFactory (plain $logger_factory parameter + setLoggerFactory()); $entityTypeManager promoted as protected, non-readonly
manual_edits.why: Pre-existing class-load fatal on every core (private readonly redeclaration of the LoggerChannelTrait property); private/readonly properties are also incompatible with DependencySerializationTrait.

manual_edits.edit: src/LegacyWidgetStorage.php: renamed the module-local helper buildRevisionCacheId() to buildWidgetRevisionCacheId() (no callers)
manual_edits.why: From Drupal 11.3 core calls ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId(); the module method silently overrode core revision-cache IDs (scan-signature-changes revision-cache-id warning).

manual_edits.edit: legacy_widgets.services.yml: service legacy_widgets.lookup class WidgetLookUp -> WidgetLookup (exact file case); dropped the comment describing the mismatch
manual_edits.why: Autoload fatal on case-sensitive filesystems (DDEV, Linux servers); port-safety class-case error class.

findings.message: legacy_widgets_entity_operation() implements hook_entity_operation(), which core invokes with 2 argument(s) from Drupal 11.3; the current 1-parameter form works on every core. If you accept the new parameter, keep it optional while the floor (10.0) is below 11.3.
findings.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
findings.d10_compat: An optional second parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.legacy_exporter' points at class Drupal\legacy_widgets\Export\LegacyExporter, but src/Export/LegacyExporter.php does not exist (orphan service): fetching it is a fatal error.
findings.suggestion: Remove the service definition, or restore/rename the class.

findings.message: Config 'legacy_widgets.settings' has no schema in config/schema/*.schema.yml: strict config schema checks (Kernel/Functional tests, config inspector) fail on it and its values are not typed or translatable.
findings.suggestion: Add a 'legacy_widgets.settings:' entry (type: config_object for simple config) to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml.

findings.message: configure: 'legacy_widgets.settings' names a route that no *.routing.yml of the extension defines: core drops the Configure link from /admin/modules silently (unless a route subscriber or another module provides it).
findings.suggestion: Point it at the real route ('legacy_widgets.settings_form'?).

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.counter' passes 3 argument(s) but Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetCounter::__construct() takes 2: PHP silently ignores the extra one(s) (a stale argument, or a constructor that lost a parameter).
findings.suggestion: Drop the extra argument(s), or restore the constructor parameter they were meant for.

findings.message: Condition plugin 'legacy_widgets_enabled' has its own settings but no 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled' schema: only core's generic 'condition.plugin.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: Filter plugin 'legacy_widgets_summary' has its own settings but no 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary' schema: only core's generic 'filter_settings.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.
